subject.title: BL-shipping-invoices-08: firma obsoleta en el pie de las facturas

question: Which approved legal/operational footer assets should replace the current ES and ENG embedded invoice footers?
rationale: The code path is clear, but choosing a valid current signer, title, stamp, and signature is a business/legal decision that automation cannot infer safely.

options.title: Provide approved ES/ENG PNG footers
options.body: Supply the final two footer images so the fix can be a narrow constant replacement plus PDF render verification.

options.title: Provide signer details for regeneration
options.body: Provide the approved signer name, role, signature/stamp asset, and layout constraints so the team can regenerate both footers.

options.title: Defer footer replacement
options.body: Keep the current implementation temporarily and leave this issue blocked until the approved legal asset exists.

recommendation.title: Provide approved ES/ENG PNG footers
recommendation.body: Supply the final two footer images so the fix can be a narrow constant replacement plus PDF render verification.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current BL divergence context and authored the invoice BL extraction that surfaced the issue.
